name: Heisei Nenkin Gekijou: Erodake
original_name: 平成粘菌劇場　えろ茸
source:
Main character is a poor student who has to go for part-time job to support himself. His payment gets delayed for a week, so he is on the brink of starvation when he finds a jar with mysterious mushrooms in his room. After he eats such a mushroom, he suddenly feels very horny. Just imagine what effect it would have on the girls he cares about!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是个穷学生，不得不打工养活自己。工资延迟了一周，他眼看就要挨饿，却在房间里发现一只装着神秘蘑菇的罐子。吃下一朵后，他突然欲火焚身。想象一下，这种蘑菇会对他在意的女孩产生怎样的效果吧！

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]]
